build_context_embeddings_jit: build a python module to generate context embeddings using a TorchScript JIT model checkpoint
build_query_embeddings_jit: build a python module to generate query embeddings using a TorchScript JIT model checkpoint
run_generate_embeddings_jit_task: run the GenerateEmbeddingsJitTask class to encode contexts and save embeddings as pickle files
run_generate_query_embeddings_jit_task: run the GenerateQueryEmbeddingsJitTask class to encode queries and save embeddings as pickle files
review_jit_eval_task_classes: review the GenerateEmbeddingsJitTask and GenerateQueryEmbeddingsJitTask classes for TorchScript-based embedding generation
